text: Which version should the release take? → 0.2.0

## What changed

The greeter now takes **`--name`** and falls back to `world`:

- `src/main.rs` parses it with clap
- `tests/cli.rs` checks it end to end
- the README example uses it

```sh
$ greeter --name Ada
hello, Ada
```

See the [clap derive tutorial](https://docs.rs/clap/latest/clap/_derive/_tutorial/index.html) for more flags.
